title: ThinkerWave answer
description: The body of GET /runs/{id}/answer: the best answer so far (or the final one), its confidence, and the evidence behind each claim.

round.description: The round this answer came from (1-based).

score.description: The round's score, 0 to 10. A high score is not proof; read the findings.

final.description: True once the run has ended; false while it may still improve.

confidence.description: How confident the agent says it is.

findings.description: The claims behind the answer, each tagged with the kind of evidence.

evidence.description: verified: checked by calculation or a source. assumption: taken as given or reasoned. guess: a hunch with no support. null: untagged.

flagged.description: True when the finding is disputed or needs a second look.

RoundAnswer.description: The answer part of an item in GET /runs/{id}/rounds (the answer without round, score and final).
